sources.title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1
sources.evidence: Names both models, identifies their identical underlying model and different safeguards, and limits Mythos access to trusted cybersecurity and life-sciences programs.

sources.title: Claude Mythos 5.1 model overview
sources.evidence: Exact claude-mythos-5-1 reference: released September 1, 2026; 1M context; adaptive thinking always on; text and image inputs and text output; active with verification required.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Fable 5.1 & Claude Mythos 5.1
sources.evidence: Downloaded official PDF after web parser rejected its size. Cover is dated September 1, 2026. Section 1 explicitly says the two configurations share identical model weights; section 1.1 describes pretraining and post-training. No model parameter count or production architecture disclosure found in extracted text.

sources.title: Anthropic Transparency Hub: Claude Mythos 5.1 Summary Table
sources.evidence: Exact Mythos 5.1 table describes text/image inputs, text output, restricted access, and training methods, but does not specify parameter counts or production architecture.

sources.title: Claude Platform release notes: September 1, 2026
sources.evidence: Explicit launch entry names claude-mythos-5-1, 1M context and always-on adaptive thinking. Tool choice auto and none remain supported; forced any/tool choices are rejected.

sources.title: PDF support
sources.evidence: All active models support PDF processing, which uses vision to process document text and images.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: API services are offered under contractual use rights; reverse engineering/duplication is restricted and intellectual-property rights are reserved. Supports descriptive proprietary licensing classification.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Opus 5.5
sources.evidence: Official later card downloaded and text-extracted; includes Mythos 5.1 comparison evaluations. No total/active parameter table or architecture disclosure for Mythos 5.1 found.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Sonnet 5.5
sources.evidence: Official later card downloaded and text-extracted for retrospective disclosures; no Mythos 5.1 parameter count or production architecture disclosure found.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Haiku 5.5
sources.evidence: Official October 7, 2026 card downloaded and text-extracted; compares Mythos 5.1 but does not disclose its parameter counts or architecture.

sources.title: Claude Mythos
sources.evidence: Product-family page lists Mythos 5.1 as a Mythos-class release and documents vetted access for cyberdefenders and life scientists.

sources.title: Models.dev Claude Mythos 5.1 record
sources.evidence: Original catalog lead accessed; used to identify the exact variant, not as primary technical verification.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. This is first-party evidence about weight availability independent of the existence of a hosted API; the paper's benchmark models are newer Claude versions.

name.note: Official product name and exact API identifier agree.

developer.note: Anthropic announces and documents this model.

family.note: Catalog slug corresponds to the explicitly named Mythos-class product family.

release_date.note: Explicit exact-model launch date; release-note entry and system-card cover agree.

open_weights.note: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. Exact-model sources document the commercial hosted offering; this classification uses the general distribution policy without transferring technical specifications from newer models.

license.note: Descriptive proprietary classification, supported by non-distribution of Claude weights and commercial hosted access; not a named open-weight redistribution license.

parameters_b.note: No production-model total count found in the exact system card, transparency entry, or later Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 5.5 comparison cards. No estimate substituted.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined active parameter count found in the inspected first-party cards; cannot derive it without a disclosed architecture/count.

architecture.note: Inspected primary cards describe training, not Transformer/dense/MoE structure. Exact-model Anthropic and Transformer Circuits research searches supplied no supporting architecture disclosure.

modalities.note: Exact reference confirms text/image input and text output; active-model PDF support establishes PDF document input, not a distinct native neural modality.

reasoning.note: Adaptive thinking is always on for this exact model.

tool_call.note: Exact-model release notes preserve automatic tool use; unsupported forced tool-choice modes do not imply absence of tool calling.

description.value: Restricted Claude model for advanced cybersecurity and biology research workflows
description.note: Conservative description agrees with the documented trusted access programs and research focus.

sources.label: Anthropic statement on Claude weight availability

summary: All 14 fields audited against exact-model primary evidence. Add proprietary license classification and replace catalog-only provenance with official sources. Release date, context, modalities, thinking, tool use, family and description are confirmed. Total parameters, active parameters and architecture remain null: the exact card and three later first-party cards disclose none. Fable 5.1 sharing is explicit in the official card, but no size or architecture is inferred from other models.
